project_name.justification: The text refers to the project as the "Clearwater West Project". For example: "SKRR Exploration Inc. Announces Letter of Intent with F3 Uranium Corp. for the Clearwater West Project, Saskatchewan".

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified as SKRR Exploration Inc. in the text: "SKRR Exploration Inc. (TSXV: SKRR) (FSE: B04Q) ("SKRR" or the "Company") is pleased to announce it has entered into a letter of intent ("LOI") with F3 Uranium Corp."

ceo_buyer.justification: The CEO of the buyer, SKRR Exploration Inc., is listed at the end of the press release: "Sherman Dahl President & CEO".

interest_acquired_percent.justification: SKRR has the option to acquire a 70% interest in the project: "...will provide SKRR with an option to acquire up to a 70% interest in F3's right, title and interest in and to the mineral claims compromising the mineral exploration project known as the 'Clearwater West Project'..."

primary_commodity.justification: The text describes the project's location in a major uranium district: "The Clearwater West Project is located ~20km outside the edge and in the south-west area of the Athabasca Basin, which is poised to become the next area for the development of major uranium mines in Saskatchewan."

verified_article_link.justification: No verifiable URL is provided in the source text.

currency.justification: The acquiring company, SKRR Exploration Inc., is listed on the TSX Venture Exchange (TSXV), a Canadian exchange, and payments are denoted with a '$' symbol, implying Canadian Dollars. "Cash payable: ... $25,000 on or before December 31, 2023;" and "Exchange: TSXV".

cash_payments_raw.justification: The total cash payment is the sum of staged payments from the original agreement ($25,000 + $25,000 + $50,000 = $100,000) and a conditional cash payment from the amendment agreement ($39,500). Original terms: "$25,000 on or before December 31, 2023; an additional $25,000 on or before December 31, 2024; and an additional $50,000 ($100,000 total) on or before December 31, 2025." Amendment terms: "SKRR shall pay $39,500 in cash to F3 in lieu thereof on or before June 5, 2024."

share_payments_raw.justification: The number of shares and a price per share are provided, so `amount_of_shares_issued` and `issued_share_price` are populated instead, according to the data extraction hierarchy.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: Cash and share payments are detailed separately, so this field is not applicable.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The total number of shares is the sum from the original agreement (5,000,000) and the amendment agreement (605,000 + 395,000 = 1,000,000). Original: "1,000,000 common shares...an additional 1,000,000...an additional 1,000,000...and an additional 2,000,000 (5,000,000 total) common shares". Amendment: "issue 605,000 common shares of SKRR to F3...and an additional 395,000 common shares of SKRR to F3".

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: The text does not mention any share warrant payments as part of the transaction.

option_payments_raw.justification: The text does not mention any stock option payments as part of the transaction consideration.

issued_share_price.justification: The transaction terms mention the number of shares issued, but not the price. Using the last traded price as a fallback, as seen in the detailed quote: 'Last: 0.225'.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The exploration commitment is specified as a monetary value, not in meters of drilling.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The total exploration commitment is $6,000,000 over three years. "Property expenditures: ... $1,000,000 within one year of Exchange Approval; an additional $2,000,000 within two years of Exchange Approval; and an additional $3,000,000 ($6,000,000 total) within three years of Exchange Approval."

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: As part of the agreement, F3 will retain a 2% NSR Royalty, which is part of the transaction terms. "2% NSR Royalty to F3 with SKRR's option to repurchase 1% (one-half) of the NSR Royalty for $1,000,000."

coverage_area_raw.justification: The total area of the project is stated in the text: "The Clearwater West property is comprised of 3 contiguous mineral claims totaling 11,786 hectares".

coverage_area_unit.justification: The unit for the coverage area is specified as hectares: "The Clearwater West property is comprised of 3 contiguous mineral claims totaling 11,786 hectares".

resource_size.justification: No mineral resource estimate is provided for the Clearwater West Project in the text. The text only refers to deposits on nearby properties.

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer's ticker and exchange are provided in the first paragraph: "SKRR Exploration Inc. (TSXV: SKRR)".
